p1.dedication: Praying for my mother Nguyen Thi Mai recovery from surgery with peace and strength.
p1.comment1: May the healing light of the Medicine Buddha protect your mother. The Sangha dedicated the morning Heart Sutra chant for her quick recovery. Peace be with your family.
p1.comment2: Sending deep prayers and positive energy for your mother! 🙏

p2.dedication: For harmony, loving kindness, and mindfulness in our family home.
p2.comment1: Where there is mindfulness, peace blooms effortlessly. Rejoicing in your family merit.

p3.dedication: Offering medicinal aid in deep gratitude for the elder monks who guide our community.
p3.comment1: Sadhu! The medicine purchased has already eased Brother Giac Dinh recovery.

p4.dedication: In loving memory of Patriarch Nguyen Van Thanh. May his gentle soul dwell in the Pure Land.
p4.comment1: His memory continues to bear sweet fruit through your generous heart. Amitabha Buddha.

p5.dedication: May the temple bells and light continue to inspire seekers of inner peace.

p6.dedication: Wishing strength and speedy healing for all sentient beings suffering from illness.

p7.dedication: For clarity of mind and wisdom for young students during exam season.
